# Prioritized candidates

The table below summarizes the highest-priority candidate regions together with network-derived evidence supporting their prioritization.

```{r}
top <- get_top_candidates(tables)
if(is.null(top)||nrow(top)==0){
  cat("No ranking table was found.")
}else{
  cols <- c("rank","input_region",if(mode!="Mode1")"input_score"else NULL,score_col,
            if(mode=="Mode2B")"celltype"else NULL,"display_gene")
  show_tbl <- top%>%slice_head(n=20)%>%select(any_of(cols))%>%drop_all_na_cols()%>%fmt_df()%>%pretty_names()
  dt_tbl(show_tbl,caption="Top 20 prioritized candidate regions",page_length=20,max_rows=20)
}
```

```{r}
if(!is.null(top)&&!is.null(score_col)&&all(c("input_region",score_col)%in%names(top))){
  plot_df <- top%>%slice_head(n=20)%>%transmute(Region=factor(input_region,levels=rev(input_region)),Score=.data[[score_col]])
  ggplot(plot_df,aes(x=Region,y=Score))+geom_col()+coord_flip()+
    labs(title="Top 20 prioritized candidate regions",x=NULL,y="Final RWR score")+theme_bw(base_size=12)
}
```

```{r}
download_links(c("ranking.tsv","top20.tsv"),report_dir)
```
